skills.description: Using a fixed camera at home or in the office, the system analyzes daily videos of an individual (e.g., adult, adolescent) and detects anxiety-related behaviors: hand rubbing (repeated rubbing of both hands), nail biting (hand approaching mouth with biting motion), and pacing (repeated back-and-forth walking in a small area). Real-time monitoring; when the anxiety-behavior index exceeds a threshold, a reminder is pushed (e.g., 'You showed more anxiety-related behaviors today — try a relaxation exercise'). Skill features: anxiety patients often display unconscious repetitive behaviors (hand-rubbing, nail-biting, pacing), which can serve as objective emotional indicators.
